## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use both arms to grab the roller with tapered ends.

Task description: The target is the light-wood rolling pin at the front right of the table, tapering toward both ends. Grasp and lift it with both arms.

Success criteria: Both arms grasp the rolling pin and lift it to a clearly suspended position above the table, with both grippers remaining closed; merely lifting it just off the table does not count as completion.

## Execution tips

- The grippers can each grasp an inward-facing section of the rolling pin, choosing thicker shaft areas with little change in diameter and leaving room to operate between them. Avoid the tapered ends to reduce slipping.
- Approach from above with closure across the rod, opening slightly wider than its diameter at the grasp point. Confirm fingers on opposite sides before closing, avoiding one finger contacting first and rolling it away.
- During the two-arm lift, coordinate movement and keep the two grasp points at a consistent distance, reducing twisting against each other or slipping from one end rising first.
